opportunities.exact_theorem: For every nonempty finite-dimensional state experiment E (possibly infinitely many labels), Cchi in nats, half-error b2 and eEB defined with one common full-domain channel, eEB <= min(1,400 sqrt((Cchi+1)/ln(1/b2))) for 0<b2<1; eEB=0 at b2=0. Dimension, cardinality, reference spectrum and output correlations are unrestricted.
opportunities.quantifier_consequence: For arbitrary finite-dimensional sequences with b2->0, Cchi+1=o(ln(1/b2)) implies eEB->0. Positive eEB requires Cchi+1 >= eEB^2 ln(1/b2)/160000.
opportunities.historical_importance: Would establish a uniform capacity-controlled quantitative route from approximate marginal broadcasting to one classical measure-and-prepare reconstruction, including growing-capacity sequences. Historical novelty/priority remains unverified.
